title: Claude Code agent frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of */agents/*.md. No maxLength on `description`. The routing text is load-bearing — it is what separates 195 commands from each other — so its size is a BUDGET question, owned by whoever tunes the always-loaded cost, not a shape question owned here. The 300/400-char caps that used to sit here described no repo that ever existed: 61 commands and 54 agents were over them the day they were written.

tools.description: Comma-STRING form only in this repo: apply-adapter-sync.sh converts `^tools:[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z]` into OpenCode's map. Gate: lint-tool-scoping.sh.
